## Summary
- refresh the Phase 0 stable-release aggregate to current main after PR #802 at 53d49a557866fb89db9a3b6b0958a5c53a3fa12d
- add the 2026-09-16 after-802 blocked evidence package with PR/run/open/closed/head snapshots, gate summaries, strict-gate expected-failure capture, commands, and checksums
- keep Phase 0 explicitly blocked with the seven remaining non-pass gates, and extend Android serial privacy detection for additional raw serial contexts

## Verification
- git diff --check origin/main...HEAD
- jq empty docs/changes/2026-08-22-phase0-stable-release-aggregate/phase0-stable-release-manifest.json docs/changes/2026-08-22-phase0-stable-release-aggregate/phase0-module-ownership-manifest.json docs/changes/2026-08-22-phase0-stable-release-aggregate/evidence/2026-09-16-after-802-current-main-gate-blocked/*.json docs/changes/2026-08-22-phase0-stable-release-aggregate/evidence/2026-09-16-after-802-current-main-gate-blocked/*.jsonl
- shasum -a 256 -c docs/changes/2026-08-22-phase0-stable-release-aggregate/evidence/2026-09-16-after-802-current-main-gate-blocked/SHA256SUMS
- rg -n "EP[0-9A-Za-z_-]{8,}|<redacted-adb-serial>" docs/changes/2026-08-22-phase0-stable-release-aggregate/evidence/2026-09-16-after-802-current-main-gate-blocked/ || true -> no matches
- git diff origin/main...HEAD | rg -n "EP[0-9A-Za-z_-]{8,}|<redacted-adb-serial>" || true -> no matches
- PYTHONDONTWRITEBYTECODE=1 PYTHONPATH=tools python3 -m unittest tools.tests.test_phase0_stable_release tools.tests.test_phase0_module_ownership -v
- make phase0-stable-release-gate PHASE0_STABLE_RELEASE_EXPECTED_SOURCE_COMMIT=$(git rev-parse HEAD)
- make phase0-module-ownership-gate
- PYTHONDONTWRITEBYTECODE=1 python3 -m unittest tests.phase3.test_repository_privacy -v
- make phase0-stable-release-gate PHASE0_STABLE_RELEASE_REQUIRE_PASS=1 PHASE0_STABLE_RELEASE_EXPECTED_SOURCE_COMMIT=$(git rev-parse HEAD) -> expected exit_code=2

## Evidence boundary
No Host launch/install, TCC/System Settings, codesign/security/keychain, adb reverse/device operation, or swift run was performed. This refresh only updates aggregate metadata and retained evidence for the current-source blocked decision.

The remaining non-pass Phase 0 gates are:
- macos_host_hardware_compatibility_matrix
- telemetry_and_latency_archive
- host_rss_2h_no_growth
- native_pointer_hid_mouse
- controller_runtime_acceptance
- clipboard_android_macos_product_e2e
- file_transfer_android_product_e2e
